# ClientScriptService

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- A **service**: get it with `game:GetService("ClientScriptService")`
- **Not creatable**: it cannot be created with `Instance.new`

Holds the client scripts of the current scene, such as its HUD, its menu or a camera. A `Script` here runs on every machine that has a player: in single-player, on a host and on a client. It never runs on a dedicated server. It is not replicated: each client runs the copy in its own build.

At startup, every file matching `src/scenes/<scene>/client/**/*.luau` becomes a `Script` under it. It belongs to the scene and is unloaded with it.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.
